durationRounds: a length in seconds truncates to whole frames instead of rounding to the nearest
inspectorExact: the inspector's timing intent sends the picked rate's whole number, so 23.976 lands as 24

label: playRebases: a running play switched from 24 to 23.976 keeps its 24 fps clock and slips a frame back
